summary: [standards] The 'silent no plans' is only closed for EIO. configured_plan_sources still answers Ok(empty) for every other read error: with canon.yaml chmod 000, dispatch begin --task c#1 answers PLAN_SOURCES_REQUIRED 'this repo configures no plan sources' (observed), and a canon.yaml that is a directory or not UTF-8 does the same. The comment in the function gives the reason for EIO (answering zero sources hides a plans: section that is there); it holds for a denied or wrong-kind read as much. Only NotFound is the legitimate first-run state. Suggest: Ok(empty) for NotFound only, PlansError::Config for any other kind (PLAN_CORPUS_DENIED / _INVALID by cause, as plan documents already do).
